name: decision
wording: a recorded choice about the conceptual design or about how it is realized, of the kind meaning or realization: its context, the decision and its consequences, recorded as open or as accepted, and later superseded; a decision about realization is a constraint the work must keep to, for a choice that cannot be observed but matters; a decision is never edited: an open one is settled by recording its acceptance, its kind by recording its classification, each an entry of its own, and an accepted one changes only by a later decision that supersedes it by name, so how a choice was reached stays readable.
